text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Who is it? Who's calling me?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait... huh? Nobody's here. I could've 
sworn I heard a voice, though...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Could you be... the Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If you're ever in trouble, just say the 
word! No matter who the opponent is, I'll 
come to your rescue!
